rationale: The efficiency-moderate bucket holds measures saving up to about 15% of the host's energy use (records/vocabulary/modifier.csv, a bucketing that follows the UKERC measure database); 8% is the middle of that band.
The efficiency-strong bucket holds measures saving more than about 15%; the UKERC strong measures cluster between 15% and 40%, so 25% is the middle of that band.
The Danish Energy Agency catalogues held here give 25 years for boilers and industrial heat pumps and 15-20 years for direct heaters (their extracted lifetime rows).
DEA's electricity and district-heating catalogue gives 25 years for gas turbines and engines and 15 for fuel cells; the EPA CHP catalog is in the same range.
DEA renewable-fuels catalogue: 25 years for low-temperature electrolysers, 20 for solid-oxide (plant life; stacks are a component).
DEA carbon-capture catalogue: 30 years for a CO2 storage well, 50 for a pipeline.
Fixed O&M over capex in the DEA industrial-process-heat and heating-installation examples held here: median 0.6-1.8% a year, quartiles 0.2-2%; 1.5% with 0.5-3% covers both catalogues.
Fixed O&M over capex in the DEA electricity catalogue's turbines, engines and CHP examples held here: median 2.8%, quartiles 2.3-3.6%; the ETSAP CHP brief gives 2.6%.
Fixed O&M over capex in the DEA renewable-fuels electrolyser examples held here: median 5.3%, quartiles 4.9-5.8%.
Fixed O&M over capex for the DEA geothermal wells and ETSAP pipeline examples held here: 2-3.2% a year.

Fixed O&M over capex for process plants in the DEA renewable-fuels catalogue (median 3.0%, quartiles 2.4-4.7%) and the ETSAP industrial briefs (3.6-4.2%) held here; the usual 3-5% process-plant convention. Also the fallback for rotating, control and mobile equipment, whose own pools are small.

Reference real discount rate for the calculated levelized cost (ruling 2026-10-10). The sources in this database that state a discount rate give a median of 8.5% (65 archetypes, 5-12%). A comparison convention, not the model's hurdle rate (design s5: apply the model's rate afterwards).
decided: modeller 2026-10-10 (variants consistent with hosts; levelized cost)
